name: @memberjunction/external-data-source-databricks
description: Databricks SQL Warehouse driver for the MemberJunction External Data Sources primitive. Registers a BaseExternalDataSourceDriver implementation via @RegisterClass(BaseExternalDataSourceDriver, 'DatabricksExternalDriver') using the official @databricks/sql SDK for live, read-only proxied access to a Databricks SQL warehouse over Unity Catalog.
author: MemberJunction.com
